howto.name: Upload a PDF
howto.text: Drop a PDF up to 500 MB. Text-heavy PDFs convert best.

howto.name: PrivaTools extracts and structures text
howto.text: Headings, paragraphs, lists, code blocks, and tables are identified by typographic cues (font size, weight, indentation).

howto.name: Download the .md file
howto.text: Open in any Markdown editor for editing or further conversion to HTML / EPUB / DOCX.

faq.q: How accurate is the structural detection?
faq.a: Headings work well when source fonts are larger. Tables transfer if cells are clearly separated. Code-block detection is a heuristic — manual review recommended.
Images are extracted to a sibling folder and referenced by Markdown image syntax.
Yes — PDF hyperlinks become Markdown links.
